card.name: Words about blocking or permitting passage
card.fires_on: Words right where a sentence is about to say something is blocked, restricted, kept away, or allowed, such as "restrict", "blocked", "not" before "allow", and "clear paths". It appears in general web prose and in drug-label text.

modes.label: Restricting or blocking verbs
modes.description: A verb or negation about stopping, limiting or eliminating something.
modes.example: an invisible wall<< blocked>> him and he could not pass

modes.label: Orders or access
modes.description: Words in a sentence about who may or may not get through or be near something.
modes.example: with strict orders<< not>> to allow anybody near the crosses

modes.label: Flow or effect on a process
modes.description: Words about whether something impedes a flow or effect, often in drug labels.
modes.example: the filter does not<< restrict>> the flow of DIPRIVAN

card.writes: It pushes toward words like lacking, absent and missing, and away from allow and allowed.
card.plain: It lights up where a sentence is about to say something is blocked, kept out or not permitted.
